aboutText: With over 10 years of experience, VIC Turf & Landscape Solutions has been Sydenham's trusted partner for all landscaping needs. Our team is dedicated to quality workmanship and customer satisfaction, ensuring every project enhances your property's value and appeal.
servicesText: From turf laying to complete garden makeovers, we offer a comprehensive range of services. Our skilled team handles everything from initial design to final installation, ensuring your vision comes to life. We cater to both residential and commercial clients in Sydenham and nearby suburbs.
